note: [N] nasqret/z-in-q-lean, proved: corank_one proves, for an abstract group A = Z^r x T with #A[2] = 4 and data K whose level-one Selmer group has 8 elements, that the reduced part vanishes and r + d = 1. The Selmer groups, Sha and the Cassels-Tate pairing are fields of PrimaryData rather than the curve's own objects, so the lemma holds for a curve once that data is supplied.

snippet.text:
theorem corank_one {A T : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup T] [Finite T]
    (K : PrimaryData A) {r : ℕ} (split : A ≃+ (Fin r → ℤ) × T)
    (tors : Nat.card (torsionAt A 2)=4) (eight : Nat.card (K.sel 1)=8) :
    Subsingleton K.reduced ∧ r + K.d = 1 := by
